name: Old Faithful Options
description: A few options and comforts for b1.7.3: Old Faithful... in Options, a screen for every switch of Old Faithful's mods (and Pure Faithful Display's), a field-of-view slider beside Difficulty, the GUI at Normal size on a first start, Quit Game on the title screen (handy in fullscreen), and, with Pure Faithful Display, a window that opens maximised the first time and where you left it after. Each has its own switch in config/oldfaithful-options.properties (the window's are in purefaithful-display.properties).
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
